name: Void Knight Equipment
effect: +10% melee accuracy and damage while the full set (including a Void melee helm) is worn - swap in the Void ranger helm for the same 10% ranged bonus, or the Void mage helm for +45% magic accuracy only (no magic damage boost at base tier).

name: Elite Void Knight Equipment
effect: Upgrades the base Void bonus: with the Void ranger helm, ranged damage rises from 10% to 12.5%; with the Void mage helm, magic gains +5% damage on top of the existing 45% accuracy. No additional bonus over regular Void for the melee helm.

name: Obsidian Armour
effect: 10% boost to melee accuracy and Strength bonus when using an Obsidian melee weapon (Toktz-xil-ak, Toktz-xil-ek, Tzhaar-ket-em, or Tzhaar-ket-om) with the full set worn; stacks with the Berserker necklace's 20% damage boost for obsidian weapons.

name: Ferocious Gloves
effect: Flat +14 Strength bonus with no defensive bonuses and -16 Ranged/Magic attack - the best-in-slot offensive gloves for melee, surpassing Barrows gloves.

name: Ahrim's Armour Set
effect: Successful magic attacks have a 25% chance to lower the target's Strength level by 5, while the full set (including the staff) is worn.

name: Dharok's Armour Set
effect: The lower your remaining Hitpoints, the higher your melee damage - up to roughly double (about 98% extra) at 1 HP - while the full set (including the greataxe) is worn.

name: Guthan's Armour Set
effect: Successful melee attacks have a 25% chance to heal you for the amount of damage dealt, while the full set (including the warspear) is worn.

name: Karil's Armour Set
effect: Successful ranged attacks have a 25% chance to lower the target's Agility level by 20%, while the full set (including the crossbow) is worn.

name: Torag's Armour Set
effect: Successful melee attacks have a 25% chance to lower the target's Run energy by 20%, while the full set (including the hammers) is worn.

name: Verac's Armour Set
effect: Melee attacks have a 25% chance to ignore the target's Defence level and any active protection prayer, while the full set (including the flail) is worn.

name: Bandos Armour
effect: No mechanical set effect - a high melee Strength bonus armour set (chestplate and tassets; the boots are excluded, as they lack the Strength bonus that defines "full Bandos").

name: Armadyl Armour
effect: No mechanical set effect - a high Ranged accuracy/Strength bonus armour set worn together for its raw stats.
